questions.stem: A strawberry plant produces runners that grow into new plants. What type of reproduction is this?

options.text: Sexual reproduction because new plants are formed
Sexual reproduction because gametes are involved
Asexual reproduction because only one parent is involved
Asexual reproduction because it requires pollination

questions.explanation: Runners are a form of asexual reproduction because only one parent is involved and no gametes fuse. The new plants are genetically identical clones of the parent.
